wallOrientation.positiveXExposed: Use first up-right bank sprite. Tangent is logical v, exposed face is screen down-right. Override incorrect source footprint axes locally.
wallOrientation.positiveYExposed: Use second down-right bank sprite. Tangent is logical u, exposed face is screen down-left.
wallOrientation.negativeEdges: No unsupported rear-face mirroring. Use rock/tree masses behind existing collision instead.

invariants: Every cell touched by a solid footprint must already be solid, and no footprint may intersect road.
Large tree trunks and roots use collision footprints; canopy overhang is visual-only and fades when it hides the hero.
All composed art entries copy identical anchor and footAnchor values.
Ground roles come from actual road/solid morphology; family choice comes from continuous authored spatial regions.

Procedural manmade props remain within the configured landmark radius. Explicit authored props use fixed per-map landmark groups or structure-linked workyard contracts and collision-checked coordinates; never map-wide random scatter.
Authored objects and connected boundary modules never occupy structural/rooted foundation cells, change mask/road, or add movement edges.
materialSelectionNote: Quiet compatible ground everywhere. High-contrast source motifs are low-frequency alpha accents, never random floor members. Source tiles remain unchanged. Material appearance never changes collision. CAVE fine-soil6 and COAST quiet-sand0 use broad restrained accents after actual renderer A/B review. MOUNTAIN remains unchanged. MOUNTAIN tiles16–19 are new flat-lit mineral source patches; no overlap-contract changes.
